# ScholarPortal

> ScholarPortal helps students discover verified global scholarships, fellowships, internships and degree programs and prepare evidence-based applications.

## Public resources
- [Opportunity directory](https://scholarportal.site/): verified opportunity discovery and official-source links
- [Application guides](https://scholarportal.site/blog): scholarship and application research
- [Degree programs](https://scholarportal.site/programs): verified academic program comparisons
- [Terms](https://scholarportal.site/terms)
- [Privacy](https://scholarportal.site/privacy-policy)

Official source pages linked from each record remain authoritative. AI-generated guidance must be reviewed before use.
